title: Accretion needs a named face
claim: Pre-registered 2026-11-10, before any computation. Accretion laws over abstract names (a board grown from a seed, each step decided by the radius-r view of a site, values from a finite alphabet, every fair order counted). To be proved: (G1) a law none of whose actions closes a cycle grows only trees; (G2) a law naming the square and carrying a marker grows exactly the plane in its only order; (G3) the square-closing law of every radius, without a marker, has a fair order whose limit is not the plane. Checks frozen in the pre-registration.
failure_conditions: An accretion law that closes no cycle and has a limit other than a forest (against G1).
A fair order of the spiral law whose limit is not the square grid, or a turn at which its board is not the expected block (against G2).
A radius r for which every fair order of the square-closing law has the square grid as its limit (against G3).
remaining_obligations: G1 to G3, or the record of which fails and why
foundation_claim_scope: Accretion laws over a countably infinite set of names with no letters; growth from a seed, every fair order; the plane as the square grid. Growth order is not part of the world (GROWTH-LAW-20261107-001).

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the coordinator's go-ahead on 2026-11-10.
validation.status: pre-registered; the proof attempt to follow
